literal_meaning: বাঁকা বা জটিল আকৃতির (crooked or intricate form)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বক্তব্যটি খুব কূট ছিল, কেউ বুঝতে পারল না।
এই কূট প্রশ্নের উত্তর খুঁজে পাওয়া কঠিন।
example_sentences_in_english: His statement was very cryptic, no one could understand it.
Finding the answer to this complex question is difficult.
history: Derived from Sanskrit 'kūṭa' meaning intricate or cunning, commonly used in classical Bengali literature.
note: Often used in compound forms like কূটনীতি (diplomacy) or কূটকবিতা (poetic riddles).
